research_question: How can we design a unified autoregressive framework that decouples visual encoding to perform both multimodal understanding (VQA) and visual generation (text-to-image) within a single Transformer architecture?
hypothesis: Decoupling visual encoding into specialized encoders for understanding and generation, while sharing a unified Transformer backbone, will improve performance on both tasks while maintaining architectural flexibility.

framework_components: Visual Understanding Encoder (VUE): CLIP-style encoder for semantic comprehension
Visual Generation Encoder (VGE): VQGAN-style tokenizer for image tokenization
Cross-Encoder Alignment: Bridge module connecting both encoders
Unified Transformer Backbone: Shared autoregressive Transformer

success_criteria: Framework successfully handles both understanding and generation tasks
Clear visualization of benefits through figures
Comprehensive research report with methodology, results, and discussion
